info.title: Primero API
info.description: Primero (primeroIMS) is UNICEF's open-source case management system for child protection, gender-based violence and family tracing. This document covers the whole of its v2 REST API, the surface the web and mobile clients use: records (cases, incidents, tracing requests, registry records and families) with their flags, alerts, attachments, approvals and transitions; the configuration surface (forms, lookups, locations, users, roles, agencies, modules); and the reporting, export and audit endpoints. Every response wraps its payload in a top-level `data` key and lists add a `metadata` object with `total`, `per` and `page`. Records are open-ended: beyond the attributes modelled here a record carries every field of every form section the caller is permitted to see, so `GET /api/v2/forms` is how a client discovers a deployment's real field set. The OpenFn primero adaptor authenticates at `POST /api/v2/tokens` and then sends the JWT as a bearer token; its generic get/post builders can reach any endpoint here.

bearerAuth.description: A JWT issued by `POST /api/v2/tokens`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Tokens expire after 60 minutes. `GET /api/v2/primero` and `GET /api/v2/identity_providers` need no token.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, or the special value `short`.

query.name: query
query.description: Free-text query over names and identifiers.

scope.name: query_scope
scope.description: Restrict the search to a module or agency scope.

locale.name: locale
locale.description: Locale for localised text in the response.

Pagination.description: Paging metadata returned alongside a list of records.

status.description: Used instead of `code` by a few endpoints.

resource.description: Path of the request that failed.

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope used by the record and configuration endpoints.

AuthErrorResponse.description: Error envelope used by the token endpoints.

RecordIdentifier.description: A bare record identifier, returned by the disable/delete endpoints.

Case.description: A case (child record). Beyond the attributes below, a case carries every field of every form section the caller is permitted to see, so the object is open-ended; use `GET /api/v2/forms` to discover the field set for a deployment.

id.description: Primero's primary key for the record.

enabled.description: False once the record has been disabled.

record_state.description: False once the record has been deleted (soft delete).

case_id_display.description: The short identifier shown in the UI.

services_section.description: Subform rows describing services and referrals.

Incident.description: An incident record. Like a case, it carries every permitted form field in addition to the attributes below.

id.description: Primero's primary key for the record.

enabled.description: False once the record has been disabled.

record_state.description: False once the record has been deleted (soft delete).

TracingRequest.description: A tracing request: an inquiry opened on behalf of someone looking for a separated child.

id.description: Primero's primary key for the record.

enabled.description: False once the record has been disabled.

record_state.description: False once the record has been deleted (soft delete).

RegistryRecord.description: A registry record: a shared registry entry (for example a farmer or household registry) a case can link to.

id.description: Primero's primary key for the record.

enabled.description: False once the record has been disabled.

record_state.description: False once the record has been deleted (soft delete).

Family.description: A family record, linking family members and the cases created from them.

id.description: Primero's primary key for the record.

enabled.description: False once the record has been disabled.

record_state.description: False once the record has been deleted (soft delete).

Trace.description: A trace: one person being traced within a tracing request.

CaseRelationship.description: A typed link between two cases.

case_id.description: The case on the other side of the relationship.

data.description: Attributes carried on the relationship itself.

MatchComparisonField.description: How one field compared between a case and a trace.

PotentialMatch.description: A scored case/trace pairing produced by the family-tracing matcher.

Flag.description: A flag raised on a record.

Alert.description: An alert raised against a record for the signed-in user.

AlertCount.description: Counts of alerts the signed-in user has, by record type.

Transition.description: Base shape for a record transition (assign, referral, transfer or transfer request).

Assign.description: An assignment: it changes the owner of a record.

Referral.description: A referral: it grants another user access to a record without changing the owner.

Transfer.description: A transfer: it starts a handover of ownership that the receiving user accepts or rejects.

TransferRequest.description: A transfer request: a user asks the current owner to transfer a record to them.

Attachment.description: A file attached to a record, stored by ActiveStorage.

record_field_scope.description: Name of the form field the file is attached to.

attachment_url.description: Relative ActiveStorage URL for the stored file.

ApprovalRecord.description: The record as it stands after an approval decision.

RecordChange.description: One field change within a record-history entry.

RecordHistory.description: One entry in a record's change history.

RecordAccessEntry.description: One entry in a record's access log: who viewed or exported it, and when.

ActivityLogEntry.description: One entry in the signed-in user's activity log.

FormField.description: A field definition inside a form section.

display_name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

help_text.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

guiding_questions.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

option_strings_source.description: Lookup the options come from, e.g. `lookup lookup-risk-level`.

option_strings_text.description: Inline options, when not sourced from a lookup.

FormSection.description: A form section: the unit of Primero's configurable record forms.

name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

description.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

form_group_name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

FormExport.description: Result of an asynchronous form-configuration export.

display_text.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

Lookup.description: A lookup: a named, localised option list referenced by form fields.

id.description: Numeric primary key of the lookup.

name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

Location.description: A location in the administrative hierarchy.

code.description: Location code, unique within the hierarchy.

name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

admin_level.description: 0 for the top level of the hierarchy.

placename.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

hierarchy.description: Codes of this location's ancestors, top down. Returned when `hierarchy=true`.

LocationImportResult.description: Outcome of a bulk location import.

UserSummary.description: A user as offered for assign/transfer/refer pickers.

UserAccess.description: The signed-in user's own identity, role and permission set.

message.description: Translation key of the message to show the user.

PasswordResetResult.description: Result of completing a password reset with a reset token.

Agency.description: An agency: the organisation a user belongs to.

name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

description.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

Role.description: A role: the permission bundle assigned to users.

PermissionCatalogue.description: Every permission a role can be granted, by resource.

resource_actions.description: Permitted actions keyed by resource name.

UserGroup.description: A user group: the unit of the `group` authorisation scope.

PrimeroModule.description: A Primero module (CP, GBV or a custom module): the record types and forms it enables.

IdentityProvider.description: An external identity provider configured for single sign-on.

Configuration.description: A saved snapshot of a Primero deployment's configuration.

data.description: The configuration payload itself; returned on the show endpoint.

ContactInformation.description: The support-contact block shown in the Primero UI.

SystemSetting.description: Deployment-wide settings: locales, age ranges, approval labels and enabled options.

welcome_email_text_i18n.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

AgencyLogo.description: Public agency branding returned by the bootstrap endpoint.

PrimeroBootstrap.description: Public information about the instance, served without authentication.

Dashboard.description: One dashboard: a named set of computed indicators plus the queries behind them.

indicators.description: Either 1-D (`{ indicator: { bucket: { count, query } } }`) or 2-D (`{ indicator: { group: { bucket: { count, query } } } }`).

SavedSearch.description: A named record-list filter saved by a user.

Task.description: A due or overdue task derived from a case's assessment, case plan, service or follow-up dates.

display_name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

Report.description: A configured aggregate report and, on the show endpoint, its computed data.

name.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

description.description: Localised text keyed by locale code (`en`, `fr`, `ar`, `es`, ...).

report_data.description: Nested counts keyed by each dimension's values.

ManagedReport.description: A built-in (code-defined) report such as the GBV or MRM managed reports.

export_file.description: Relative URL of the generated file, once the job completes.

WebpushConfig.description: Browser push configuration for this instance.

WebpushSubscription.description: A browser push subscription belonging to a user.

CodeOfConduct.description: The code of conduct users must accept.

UsageReport.description: Quarterly usage statistics for the instance.

UnusedFieldsReport.description: A link to the generated unused-fields report file.

KeyPerformanceIndicator.description: One computed key performance indicator; the shape depends on the indicator.

TokenResponse.description: Confirmation that a token was issued. The JWT itself is returned in the response's `Authorization` header (`Bearer <token>`), not in the body, and expires after 60 minutes.

IntakeResult.description: The record created from an intake submission.

BulkUpdateResult.description: Outcome of a bulk user update.

TokenRequest.description: Credentials for issuing a token. Omit the body and send a valid `Authorization` header to refresh instead.
